category_title: Beginning communicators with complex support needs and complex communication needs who struggle with attention
scenario_title: Passive disengagement and attention struggles during shared reading
minimal_context: The teacher and student are participating in a shared reading session using a book and communication devices.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's read 'All You Need for a Snowman'. Look at all this snow! Hit your switch to turn the page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Hits the single message voice output device with a fisted hand to respond to the direct request, sitting back in his manual wheelchair.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Good job. Now look at this big snowman. Is he cold?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Uses a head nod to answer the yes or no question, but otherwise remains a passive observer.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Pay attention to the story, Cody. Use your communication board to tell me about the snowman.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows no interest in his personal aided AAC device. He turns his head to the side to refuse, demonstrating disinterest and non-engagement as he struggles with attention.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's read 'All You Need for a Snowman'. Look at all this snow! Hit your switch to turn the page.

STUDENT: (Hits the single message voice output device with a fisted hand to respond to the direct request, sitting back in his manual wheelchair.)

TUTOR: Good job. Now look at this big snowman. Is he cold?

STUDENT: (Uses a head nod to answer the yes or no question, but otherwise remains a passive observer.)

TUTOR: Pay attention to the story, Cody. Use your communication board to tell me about the snowman.

STUDENT: (Shows no interest in his personal aided AAC device. He turns his head to the side to refuse, demonstrating disinterest and non-engagement as he struggles with attention.)

task.content: Participating in shared reading instruction (e.g., reading 'Spookyrumpus' or 'All You Need for a Snowman')
task.learning_goal: Develop joint attention and communication skills, and foster flexible language learning

context.environment: Instructional setting during shared reading sessions
context.materials: Books, manual wheelchair, personal aided AAC device with graphic symbols, single message voice output devices
context.time_context: Beginning of the year / initial sessions

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher reads the book with animation but does not use aided language input, does not provide access to aided AAC, or limits interaction to direct requests and single message voice output devices
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Acts as a primarily passive observer, struggles with attention, shows non-engagement, and only responds to direct requests

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Turned his head to the side or shook his head

behavior_patterns.condition: When attempting to obtain objects or engage in social interactions
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Gazed between people and desired objects, nodded his head, waved to greet people, or raised his hand to get attention

behavior_patterns.condition: When provided with a personal aided AAC device without proper modeling
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Showed no interest in it, despite having the physical ability to isolate and extend his right index finger
